name: Propylene oxide (HPPO, PO/SM)
principle: In the HPPO route hydrogen peroxide oxidises propylene to propylene oxide over a titanium silicalite (TS-1) catalyst with water as the only co-product, avoiding the styrene or tert-butanol co-products of PO/SM and PO/TBA routes. Evonik and thyssenkrupp Uhde developed it from 2000; the first plant at Ulsan, Korea (SKC) started in 2008 at 100,000 t/yr and expanded to 130,000 t/yr.

source.note: Evonik, HPPO technology page, read 25 October 2026

performance.basis: "Through HPPO, propylene oxide can be synthesized directly from hydrogen peroxide without generating any co-products other than water" (Chemical Engineering, 5 Sep 2023, on the new Evonik-Uhde HPPO complex in China); the classic wastewater/energy savings percentages were not stated in the open pages read
